notes: ART_BIBLE 6: 'The cardboard box is a strong asset: matte, fibrous, warm neutral against every biome palette.' brushScale is deliberately the smallest in the project (0.5m) — cardboard fibre is the one surface in the game whose grain is genuinely finer than a brush stroke, and the LOD ladder in painterly.ts keeps it at a constant projected size so it does not alias at any range. The region octave is stepped down hard (regionStep 0.22 against the 0.7 default): at chase-camera range the coarse rung is ~100 screen pixels, which on a 1.7 m box face is one blotch covering half of it and reads as a stain rather than as fibre. Shadow is authored WARM and cooled at runtime by shadowSkyTint, per the rule that shadows rotate toward the live sky hue rather than being baked cool.
